thread:
Alex (Partnerships): Heads-up: vendor wants one manifest for H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi but with variant aliases per region. We need a concise onramp plan to avoid mixed SKU strings in listings.
Priyanka (Platform): Ok. We can support canonical->aliases in manifest (JSON key `aliases`). That keeps one listing ID but accepts multiple incoming SKU strings. Will need signed container tags for CI.
Ned (Billing): Billing requires the canonical string to be the ledger key. Aliases are fine as long as we map them before any invoices hit. Need the mapping by Thu EOD.
Yumi (Marketing): Localization is in flight; please don't change strings after Wed. If aliases arrive late we'll use family names in copy and swap SKUs post-announce.
Alex (Partnerships): Vendor please confirm canonical SKUs + alias list and publish signed containers with SHA256. Also confirm whether APAC variants differ.
vendor-pm: Confirmed canonical SKUs: `H200-48G-v2`, `MI300-128A`, `B200-32G`. APAC adds alias `B200-slim-16A`. Signed containers will be published tomorrow with checksums.
Priyanka (Platform): Good. Plan: 1) ingest signed container -> CI rebuild (24-36h), 2) produce manifest with aliases, 3) marketing swap placeholders, 4) billing merges alias PR.
Ned (Billing): I'll draft alias PR mapping canonical -> [aliases] and mark it `do-not-merge` until vendor confirms checksums.
Yumi (Marketing): Locking copy to family names until manifest is live. Staging page: https://redwood.example/embargo/sku_hold.
Alex (Partnerships): Meeting 20m to confirm roll-forward. Agenda: manifest schema, CI gating, billing merge criteria, marketing swap timeline. If vendor misses signed artifacts we fallback to family-only copy and "rolling availability" footnote.
